jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

DOA Management Engineer (d/f/m)

We are looking for a DOA Management Engineer (d/f/m) to join our team and support the management and coordination of activities related to the Design Organisation Approvals (DOAs) in Airbus Defence and Space GmbH.

You will be responsible for managing approval processes within the Design Organisation, ensuring that the relevant manuals, procedures and documentation are properly maintained, updated and implemented in accordance with applicable requirements.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Manage approval processes and ensure compliance with applicable aviation regulations, airworthiness standards, and organisational requirements
- Support DOA Management in ensuring compliance with applicable aviation regulations and organisational requirements.
- Act as a central point of coordination between DOA Management, internal Design Organisation departments, and National Airworthiness Authorities.
- Coordinate the preparation, review, approval, and implementation of DOA manuals, procedures, and controlled documentation.
- Monitor approval statuses to ensure key actions and deliverables are completed within designated timeframes.
- Support the implementation of structural changes to Design Organisation procedures and systems.
- Facilitate proactive communication and alignment across stakeholders.
- Participate in internal reviews, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives related to the DOA system.
- Maintain rigorous document control and ensure full traceability across all records.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Degree in Aerospace Engineering or a related technical discipline, paired with professional experience in the aerospace industry or a highly regulated environment.
- Proven experience within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or airworthiness environment, with strong knowledge of German Defence Airworthiness regulations and Design Organisation Approval (DOA) requirements and experience working with manuals, procedures, approvals and controlled documentation.
- Hands-on expertise with controlled documentation, including the preparation, maintenance, and management of DOA manuals, procedures, and compliance records.
- Familiarity with quality management systems and regulatory compliance frameworks in aviation.
- Strong organizational and coordination skills, characterized by a structured, methodical approach to work and high attention to detail.
- Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and authorities.
- Fluency in German and English (both written and spoken).

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

About us

Job description

In order to support Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Supply Chain and Quality Manager (d/f/m)

Airbus Defence and Space is seeking a highly skilled and strategic Supply Chain and Quality Manager (d/f/m) to join our team in Manching.

In this critical role, you will be the driving force behind the performance of our Systems & Equipment supply chain. You will not only manage contract execution and supplier performance but will also act as a key technical and strategic interface. You are a technical expert in aerospace systems and equipment, possessing the ability to bridge the gap between complex engineering requirements and robust supply chain execution.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Strategic Supplier Management: Drive contract execution with a focus on On-Quality, On-Time (OQOT) deliveries. You will protect business operations by managing milestones, product life cycle reviews, and technical deliverables.
- Systems & Equipment Oversight: Manage the end-to-end supply chain for complex systems and equipment integrated into combat and UAV platforms. Ensure all components meet stringent defense-grade specifications.
- Performance Recovery & Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify technical and supply risks within the systems ecosystem. Implement preventative surveillance plans and robust recovery actions to ensure zero disruption to combat-ready platforms.
- Stakeholder Leadership: Act as the key technical interface between Engineering, Procurement, and external Tier-1 system suppliers. Contribute to Sub-Commodity strategies through active participation in Multi-Functional Teams (MFT).
- Technical Quality Assurance: Secure industrial maturity by conducting specialized supplier audits and assessments (e.g., APQP, IPCA, CCPs, Transfers of Work). You will manage corrective action plans to eliminate deviations and concessions.
- Global Oversight: While based in Manching, you will conduct on-site supplier audits and technical assessments at various locations worldwide to ensure compliance with defense standards and operational excellence.
- Governance: Contribute to Vendor Review Board (VRB) meetings and represent SCQ Operations in high-level forums.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Systems & Equipment Expertise: Advanced technical knowledge or proven expertise in Systems and Equipment (Avionics, Mission Systems, Sensors, or specialized UAV hardware) within the context of combat or unmanned aerial platforms.
- Education & Experience: Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field and professional experience in a highly regulated industry (Aerospace preferred).
- Audit & Quality Mastery: Demonstrated experience in auditing (preferably as Airbus Supplier Lead Auditor), assessing supplier capability, and managing industrial maturity (APQP/PPAP frameworks).
- Language Proficiency: Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. You must be able to negotiate and lead technical discussions in both languages.
- Defense Mindset: A deep understanding of the unique quality, security, and reliability requirements of combat and unmanned systems.
- Change Management: Proven ability to work autonomously in complex Supply Chain Change Management environments involving highly sensitive technology.
- Tools: Proficiency in Procurement IT tools and ERP systems.
- Analytical Leadership: Ability to monitor complex performance metrics and lead data-driven recovery actions for sophisticated technical components.
- Mobility: Willingness and ability to travel internationally for supplier audits and site visits.

jobs.occupation: Internship / Master Thesis: Advanced Power Electronics & Hardware Design (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Job description

In order to support Electrification Technologies department, Airbus Defence and Space is offering an

Internship / Master Thesis: Advanced Power Electronics & Hardware Design (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship or a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a Power Electronics Researcher (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Electrification Technologies department as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn
- Start: December 2026
- Duration: 5-6 months

Are you passionate about power electronics and eager to work on next-generation hardware designs? We offer a flexible and exciting opportunity – whether you are looking for an Internship or a Master Thesis. Join our team to design, simulate, and build innovative power electronic converter systems.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Research & Exploration: Investigate modern semiconductor devices (e.g., SiC, GaN)
and innovative converter topologies suited for high-performance applications.
- Simulation & Modeling: Use PLECS and LTSpice to model converter topologies,
analyze circuit behavior, and validate design concepts prior to prototyping.
- Hardware Design: Design and develop PCBs for power electronic prototypes, focusing on optimized layout for fast switching and low parasitic inductance.
- Prototyping & Testing: Assembly, testing, and initial operation of power electronic
circuits in the laboratory, verifying simulation results with real-world measurements.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student within Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering or a similar field of studies.
- A solid understanding of basic power electronics components and inverter topologies.
- Proven experience in PCB design and layout (preferably in KiCAD). This is essential for the practical aspects of the work.
- Proficiency and enthusiasm for circuit simulation using tools like PLECS and LTSpice, geared towards research and rapid prototyping.
- A proactive, curious, and analytical approach to problem-solving.
- Fluent communication skills in English and German.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

jobs.employer_name: Universitätsklinikum der Technischen Universität München AöR
jobs.description:
Full- or part-time | temporary (24 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für RadioOnkologie und Strahlentherapie

The Department of Radiation Oncology at TUM University hospital is recruiting a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our Radiation Biology Research Group.

Our research focuses on translating novel radiotherapy concepts from experimental models toward clinical application, with a particular emphasis on spatially fractionated radiotherapy (SFRT). We aim to understand the biological mechanisms underlying tumor response and normal-tissue tolerance and to establish the preclinical evidence required for future clinical trials.

The position offers the opportunity to work at the interface of radiobiology, radiation oncology, and medical physics within an interdisciplinary translational research environment.

Your responsibilities:

- Irradiation and dosimetry of mouse cohorts using MBRT and conventional radiation, across single- vs. multi-fraction regimens
- Longitudinal neurobehavioral testing 
- Histological and immunohistochemical analysis of neuroinflammation, vascular, and structural brain changes
- Neurotransmitter profiling and biomarker analysis 
- Statistical and integrative analysis of dose-response and biomarker data to define normal-brain tolerance thresholds
- Close collaboration with scientists and clinicians from radiation oncology, medical physics, and radiobiology, and translation of findings into clinically relevant concepts for future MBRT trials

Your profile:

- We are looking for a highly motivated scientist with a strong interest in experimental and translational radiation oncology and radiobiology 
- A doctoral degree in biology, biomedical sciences, veterinary medicine, or a related field is required 
- Experience with preclinical in vivo models and animal experimentation is desirable 
- Expertise in tumor cell culture, histology, immunohistochemistry, or molecular biology would be an advantage 
- A background in radiation biology and radiation-induced normal-tissue effects would be advantageous 
- The ability to independently plan, conduct, analyze, and document experimental studies is expected 
- A strong interest in interdisciplinary and translational research at the interface of radiation oncology, medical physics, and biology is essential 
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary research environment are required 
- Flexibility and mobility to make full use of the scientific opportunities and research infrastructure available across TUM sites (TUM University Hospital Rechts der Isar and the Garching Research Campus) 
- Good written and spoken English skills are essential 

We offer you:

- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram 
- Company pension plan through the Federal and State Pension Institute (VBL) 
- Self-realization through a varied and technically demanding job with interdisciplinary cooperation between various departments of the TUM Klinikum

We look forward to meeting you!

Kontakt: Frau Daniela Schilling | 089 / 4140 –9403 | Klinik und Poliklinik für RadioOnkologie und Strahlentherapie

Klinik und Poliklinik für RadioOnkologie und Strahlentherapie

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

The Coating Engineer is part of a team of Mechanical and Materials Engineers within the Turbine Design Department. The purpose of this team is to support the development of new turbine components during design and process qualification and to disposition manufacturing non conformances of existing hardware. Also, an important aspect of this position will be to help implement and industrialize new coating technologies from technological development into the manufacturing environment in collaboration with internal and external technology development, manufacturing and sourcing organizations. Collaborate with certification bodies and internal certification intermediaries.

Engage in Audit sessions together with internal and external auditors.

You’re an open-minded team player.

Industry recognized professional certification such as CISSP, CISA, Lead Auditor or SANS

Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automating compliance tasks and evidence gathering

Experience with using AI tools such as Claude.

Spoken and written German communication skills

The Information Security team is responsible for managing the security of SAP LeanIX enterprise architecture solution in coordination with Product and Engineering organization as well as SAP’s central security team.
